strips.title: A commute with the Sony WF-1000XM6

panels.head: 7:40 AM — the train hum
panels.text: Tap once. Tier-1 noise cancelling takes the rumble down to almost nothing.

panels.head: A call on a windy platform
panels.text: Class-leading mics: the other side hears you, not the wind.

panels.head: 3 min in the case = 1 hour
panels.text: Forgot to charge? A quick top-up covers the ride home.

panels.head: 9 hours later, still going
panels.text: Measured 9h41m with ANC on. Works the same on iPhone and Android.
